findings.summary: crates/setup/src/app.rs:117: install_key runs even when match_repos failed. If the owner picks "All repositories" on the install page (line 261 bails), or a PUT/DELETE fails partway through, the run still writes the App's key into sdlc-board-tokens and drops GITHUB_TOKEN. The board is then left holding a credential that can read Contents and PRs on repos beyond deploy/values.yaml, which AC-2 doesn't allow. The run exits non-zero and says what to fix, and the server scopes each token to one repo, so this is not blocking. A tighter fix: when the selection is "all", stop before install_key, or put the key in only once the installation covers exactly the board's repos.

decision: Open the PR and advance to PR review
